proposals.statement: The client misses collections because messages get buried in the current WhatsApp-based dispatch process

evidence.quote: Dispatch happens on WhatsApp, the controller posts the collections in a group, the drivers reply, and then somebody types it all into a shared spreadsheet at night. We miss collections because messages get buried.

proposals.statement: The app must ensure every collection is assigned and confirmed by the driver

evidence.quote: So the app has to make sure every collection is assigned and confirmed.

proposals.statement: The app must allow drivers to accept jobs, mark collections as completed, take photos of the wabel, and get signatures

evidence.quote: Accept the job, mark it collected, take a photo of the wabel, and get a signature.

proposals.statement: The app must work offline and synchronize data when drivers regain internet connectivity

evidence.quote: It has to work off line and send everything when

evidence.quote: A re-delivery is about 1800 Rand and we lose the client's trust, which is worse. Last December, we lost one retail account over it.
